sources.entry: Corteza - CRM including a unified workspace, enterprise messaging and a low code environment for rapidly and securely delivering records-based management solutions. (Demo, Source Code) Apache-2.0 Go

summary.one_liner: Corteza is an open-source, Go-based low-code platform for building CRM, business process and other structured-data apps, with workflows and integrations.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Corteza as a low-code platform for building CRM, business process and other structured data applications, plus automated business process workflows and connections to data sources. It states it is API-centric, with a flexible data storage layer and automation facilities for integrating with external services and other Corteza instances. It describes a flattened role-based access control (RBAC) model for security and features aimed at configuring data privacy compliance. The README also says the interface is designed to conform to WCAG 2.1 accessibility guidelines and that the product is customizable, including translations, terminology and prebuilt low-code applications. Documentation covers setup via a DevOps guide, the Integrator Guide, Compose configuration, workflows and automation scripts, and the REST API.
use_cases: connect structured data from multiple sources
how_to_run: Refer to the DevOps guide in the Corteza documentation for installation and setup
Optionally use the online demo instance for hands-on exploration
notable: Low-code builder for CRM and records-based apps
API-centric design for integrating with other Corteza instances
caveats: Planet Crust offers hosted cloud instances as the easiest starting point, implying self-hosting requires setup effort
Setup details are in external guides rather than the README itself
